risk_note: RV2 (packages/domain, pure functions; settlement-plan B2-04e, BR-FUND-04 ⑩⑫, BR-FUND-05, BR-FUND-19 ⑤, BR-CALC-02 / 04 / 13). Credit plan functions with no IO: planInitialCredit (per beneficiary credit / hold as an open obligation / forfeit, platform share plus reserve from the snapshot and B_credit), planBeneficiaryCredit (supplementary credit of the unfulfilled amount for first-credit and deferred-difference obligations, both paths: still frozen or appealing keeps holding, minor / deleting / deleted / banned forfeits with a forfeited event, zero amount completes without a voucher) and checkCreditInvariant (the ⑤ equality before execution). Money only through @couli/money on bigint fen, floor division. Self-defined where 08 is silent: forfeiture reason precedence deleted > banned > minor; execution preconditions checked first, then obligations matched to positions (RangeError on mismatch), then ⑤ (skip and alert when it fails); unknown states throw RangeError instead of producing a plan.
